title: Bottle on a Kitchen Counter
tests: Tests replacing a product photo's setting while preserving the actual product and making its placement believable.

got.question: May I use an image edit that closely preserves the bottle but cannot guarantee it remains pixel-for-pixel unchanged?

faults.what: The bottle has conspicuous blurred halos and smeared background remnants around its outline, especially along the cap, shoulders, and sides.
No light stone counter or tidy modern kitchen is visible; the bottle appears against a dark, indistinct background.
The base lacks a clearly defined supporting surface and believable contact shadow, leaving the bottle poorly grounded.

judge.summary: The same bottle remains recognizable in a square image, but the rough cutout has severe edge halos and lacks the requested kitchen setting.

must_haves.item: The same matte black bottle is recognizable, with its shape and visible details preserved.
must_haves.why: The bottle's silhouette, matte black body, cap loop, lid seam, and lower-body markings remain recognizable and consistent with the source.

must_haves.item: The bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter rather than the original wooden table.
must_haves.why: There is no visible light stone countertop.

must_haves.item: A tidy modern kitchen is visible behind the bottle.
must_haves.why: The background is dark and indistinct, with no visible kitchen.

must_haves.item: The bottle has clean edges and a believable contact shadow, without appearing to float.
must_haves.why: Strong fuzzy halos and residual background colors surround the bottle, and its base is not convincingly grounded on a surface.

must_haves.item: The output is square and has no added text.
must_haves.why: The image is square and contains no visible added text.
